subject: Physics
title: Alternating Current
summary: AC mein voltage aur current sinusoidal badalte hain: v = V₀ sinωt. Ghar ki supply 220 V, 50 Hz — yeh 220 V RMS value hai, peak ≈ 311 V. Ek cycle ka average zero hota hai, isliye heating ke liye RMS use karte hain.
Resistor mein V aur I same phase mein. Inductor current ko 90° peeche rakhta hai (X_L = ωL, frequency badhe to rokna badhe), capacitor 90° aage (X_C = 1/ωC, DC ko poora rokta hai).
Series LCR mein total rukawat impedance Z = √(R² + (X_L − X_C)²). Jab X_L = X_C, Z = R minimum aur current maximum — resonance (ω₀ = 1/√LC). Radio tuning isi par hoti hai.
Power sirf resistor khaata hai: P = V_rms I_rms cosφ. Pure L ya C mein average power zero (wattless current). Transformer voltage badal ke bijli door tak kam loss mein bhejta hai.

formulas.name: Instantaneous AC
formulas.formula: v = V₀ sin ωt;   i = I₀ sin(ωt ± φ);   ω = 2πf
formulas.mistake: ω ko f mat samjho — 314 rad/s matlab 50 Hz.

formulas.name: RMS and average values
formulas.formula: V_rms = V₀/√2 ≈ 0.707V₀;   I_rms = I₀/√2;   half-cycle average = 2V₀/π ≈ 0.637V₀;   full cycle average = 0
formulas.mistake: AC voltmeter/ammeter RMS padhte hain; 220 V supply ka peak 311 V hai, 220 nahi.

formulas.name: Inductive reactance
formulas.formula: X_L = ωL = 2πfL;   current V se 90° peeche
formulas.mistake: DC (f = 0) par X_L = 0 — inductor DC ko nahi rokta.

formulas.name: Capacitive reactance
formulas.note: DC par X_C = ∞ — capacitor DC ko poora rok deta hai.

formulas.name: Series LCR impedance
formulas.mistake: Voltages seedhe nahi judte: V = √(V_R² + (V_L − V_C)²); V_L aur V_C alag-alag supply se bade ho sakte hain.

formulas.name: Phase angle
formulas.formula: tanφ = (X_L − X_C)/R;   X_L > X_C: current peeche (inductive), X_L < X_C: aage (capacitive)
formulas.mistake: φ voltage aur CURRENT ke beech hai, do voltages ke beech nahi.

formulas.name: Resonance
formulas.formula: X_L = X_C ⇒ ω₀ = 1/√(LC), f₀ = 1/(2π√(LC));   Z = R, current max, φ = 0
formulas.mistake: Resonance R par depend nahi karta; R sirf peak ki height/sharpness badalta hai.

formulas.name: Quality factor and bandwidth
formulas.formula: Q = ω₀L/R = (1/R)√(L/C);   bandwidth Δω = R/L = ω₀/Q
formulas.note: Q zyada = sharp peak = kam R.

formulas.name: Power in AC
formulas.formula: P_avg = V_rms I_rms cosφ = I_rms² R;   power factor cosφ = R/Z
formulas.mistake: V_rms × I_rms 'apparent power' hai, asli power nahi (cosφ chhoot gaya).

formulas.name: Wattless current
formulas.formula: Power deta component: I_rms cosφ;   wattless component: I_rms sinφ
formulas.when: Pure L/C ya power factor ka sawal.
formulas.note: Pure L ya C mein current behta hai par average power zero.

formulas.name: LC oscillations
formulas.formula: ω = 1/√(LC);   energy C ke electric field aur L ke magnetic field ke beech aati-jaati;   q = q₀ cosωt
formulas.note: Resistance ho to oscillations dheere-dheere khatam (damped).

formulas.name: Transformer
formulas.formula: V_s/V_p = N_s/N_p = I_p/I_s  (ideal);   efficiency η = P_out/P_in
formulas.mistake: Transformer sirf AC par chalta hai; DC par sirf heating hogi.

formulas.name: AC generator
formulas.note: Coil ka plane B ke parallel ho tab emf max hota hai (flux zero par, badlaav sabse tez).

examples.title: RMS aur frequency
examples.problem: v = 311 sin(314t) volt. RMS voltage aur frequency?
examples.solution: V_rms = 311/√2 ≈ 220 V. f = 314/2π ≈ 50 Hz — yahi ghar ki supply hai.

examples.title: Reactances 50 Hz par
examples.problem: L = 0.1 H aur C = 100 μF ka 50 Hz par reactance?

examples.title: Series LCR poora
examples.problem: R = 30 Ω, X_L = 80 Ω, X_C = 40 Ω, V_rms = 200 V. Z, current, power factor, power, phase?

examples.title: Resonance
examples.problem: L = 0.5 H, C = 8 μF, R = 10 Ω. Resonant ω, f aur Q?

examples.title: Step-up transformer
examples.problem: N_p = 200, N_s = 4000, V_p = 220 V. V_s? Secondary mein 0.5 A ho to primary current (ideal)?

examples.title: Wattless current
examples.problem: I_rms = 5 A, current voltage se 60° peeche. Wattless component aur power factor?
examples.solution: Wattless = I sinφ = 5 × 0.866 = 4.33 A. Power factor = cos60° = 0.5.

examples.title: Bulb ke saath choke
examples.problem: 100 V, 50 W ka bulb 200 V, 50 Hz supply par chalana hai, series mein inductor lagaakar. L kitna?
examples.solution: Bulb: I = 50/100 = 0.5 A, R = 100/0.5 = 200 Ω. Z = 200/0.5 = 400 Ω. X_L = √(400² − 200²) ≈ 346.4 Ω. L = X_L/(2π × 50) ≈ 1.1 H. (Resistor lagaate to usme bhi 50 W jalta — choke mein lagbhag zero.)

examples.title: LC circuit ki frequency
examples.problem: L = 10 mH, C = 1 μF. Oscillation frequency?

examples.title: Transformer efficiency
examples.problem: Upar wala transformer 90% efficient ho aur output 4400 V × 0.5 A ho. Input power?
examples.solution: P_out = 2200 W. P_in = 2200/0.9 ≈ 2444 W. Baaki ~244 W heat mein (copper, eddy, hysteresis losses).

topics.title: Peak aur RMS kyun
topics.explain: RMS value woh DC value hai jo resistor mein utni hi heat de. Sine wave ka RMS = peak/√2. Meters RMS dikhaate hain; insulation aur capacitor rating peak ke liye chahiye.

topics.title: Phasors
topics.explain: AC quantities ko ghoomte arrows (phasors) se dikhaate hain jo ω se ghoomte hain. R mein V aur I ek line mein; L mein V, I se 90° aage; C mein V, I se 90° peeche. LCR mein V_L aur V_C ulte, isliye ek doosre ko kaatte hain.

topics.title: Reactance aur impedance
topics.explain: Reactance (X_L, X_C) bhi ohm mein hai lekin energy kharch nahi karta — sirf store karke wapas deta hai. Impedance Z poori rukawat hai (R + reactance, vector ki tarah judte hain).

topics.title: Resonance ke facts
topics.explain: Resonance par V_L = V_C (ek doosre ko cancel), circuit pure resistive, current max, power max. f < f₀ par circuit capacitive, f > f₀ par inductive. Radio/TV tuning mein C badalkar f₀ station ki frequency par laate hain.

topics.title: Power in AC circuits
topics.explain: Average power = V_rms I_rms cosφ. Pure R: cosφ = 1. Pure L/C: cosφ = 0 (wattless). Factories mein low power factor = zyada current = zyada line loss, isliye capacitors lagaakar power factor sudhaarte hain.

topics.title: Transformer ki working aur losses
topics.explain: Primary ka AC core mein badalta flux banata hai, jo secondary mein emf jagaata hai (mutual induction). Losses: copper (I²R, moti wire), eddy current (laminated core), hysteresis (soft iron), flux leakage. Bijli high voltage par bhejte hain taaki current kam ho aur I²R loss kam.

topics.title: AC generator
topics.explain: Coil ghoomne se flux NBA cosωt badalta hai ⇒ emf NBAω sinωt. Slip rings se AC milta hai. India mein f = 50 Hz.

ratta: V_rms = V₀/√2;  220 V ⇒ peak 311 V;  half-cycle average 2V₀/π.
P = V_rms I_rms cosφ;  cosφ = R/Z.
Transformer losses: copper, eddy, hysteresis, leakage.
